name: The Perfect Stout
summary: In Brewnall Village, Rejold Barleybrew still pursues The Perfect Stout. He draws on family brewing tradition and exotic local ingredients, and now seeks shimmerweed, a pungent plant cultivated only by the hostile Frostmane trolls atop Shimmer Ridge. He sends daring travelers into their encampment to take the herb from tribal baskets.

sections.title: A Brewer's Ambition
sections.body: Brewing is a way of life in Brewnall Village, especially for the Barleybrew family. Rejold Barleybrew believes greatness runs in his blood, but the perfect stout calls for new ideas. He looks beyond hops, malt and mountain spring water to Dun Morogh's untamed plants, hoping they will give his ale an unmistakable bite.

sections.title: The Troll Herb of Shimmer Ridge
sections.body: East of Brewnall Village, the Frostmane trolls cultivate shimmerweed on Shimmer Ridge. They gather it for tribal and mystic rituals, while dwarves know it for its sharp, distinct flavor. The herb is kept in baskets in the troll village, where Rejold's latest and boldest brewing experiment awaits it.

faq.answer: Shimmerweed is a distinct plant grown and harvested by the Frostmane trolls on Shimmer Ridge. They use it mainly in tribal ceremonies and rituals, while Rejold Barleybrew hopes its sharp flavor will bring something new to dwarven brewing.
Shimmer Ridge rises in northern Dun Morogh, east of Brewnall Village. It is a fortified camp for the indigenous Frostmane trolls, so gathering herbs there means entering hostile territory.

faq.q: Why does Rejold want to steal from the Frostmane trolls?
faq.answer: The Frostmane trolls alone cultivate shimmerweed in Dun Morogh, and tensions between dwarves and trolls make peaceful trade impossible. Rejold's only option is to sneak into their encampment or fight through it to seize the harvested plants from their tribal baskets.
Rejold Barleybrew is an ambitious dwarf brewer who lives in Brewnall Village. He experiments with new flavors and potent wild ingredients in pursuit of the perfect stout.

faq.q: Is shimmerweed considered an alchemy herb?
faq.answer: No. Shimmerweed is not an alchemical reagent gathered from wild nodes. It is the sought-after item stored in wicker baskets and caches throughout the Frostmane settlements atop Shimmer Ridge.

faq.q: What becomes of the shimmerweed once turned in?
faq.answer: When the shimmerweed reaches him in Brewnall Village, Rejold throws it into an active fermentation batch. He hopes its unique flavor will finally unlock the flawless recipe he seeks.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know brewing is nearly sacred to the Bronzebeard clan. Finding an exotic herb to outdo rival taverns is a noble pursuit.
As a herbalist, you may find shimmerweed an intriguing novelty. Its unusual botanical traits let it endure the frozen crags of Dun Morogh.
